description: Change a SIP trunk: rename it, add an origination address (or remove one by removeOriginationId on Twilio), add or remove numbers (a removed Telnyx number goes back to Hermoso's call handling), and on Telnyx set its outbound voice profile or a new SIP password. Free. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: update_sip_trunk
title: Change a SIP trunk
